title.tr: Kepenkli pencereli, kırmızı kapılı ahşap ev
title.en: Timber house with a red door and a shuttered window

alt.tr: Kırmızı kapılı, yan duvarında kepenkli penceresi olan küçük ahşap ev; kauçuk zeminde
alt.en: Small timber house with a red door and a shuttered window on its side wall, on a rubber floor

caption.tr: Evin yan yüzünde küçük kepenkli bir pencere var, ön yüzünde kemerli kırmızı kapı. Çatı pul biçimli tahtalarla örtülü.
caption.en: The side of the house has a small shuttered window and the front a red arched door. The roof is covered in scale-shaped boards.
